title: Federal Solar Tax Credit 2026: A Guide for American Homeowners
excerpt: Learn about the federal solar tax credit and how it can help you save thousands on your solar panel installation.
content:
What is the Federal Solar Tax Credit?

The federal solar tax credit, also known as the Investment Tax Credit (ITC), is a tax incentive that allows homeowners to claim a credit of up to 30% of the total cost of their solar panel installation against their federal income tax liability.

Eligibility and Requirements

To be eligible for the federal solar tax credit, homeowners must meet certain requirements, including owning the solar panel system, using it for residential purposes, and having the system installed in the United States.

How to Claim the Credit

To claim the federal solar tax credit, homeowners must file Form 5695 with their federal tax return and include documentation of the solar panel installation, such as a receipt and a copy of the certification from the manufacturer.
